title: Remove command issue-level flat alias
summary: Removed the transitional flat window.commandHistoryIssueLevel export while preserving mediaPipelineCommandHistory.commandHistoryIssueLevel and routing touched WebView consumers through the namespace.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in the command-history domain without changing backend-owned command behavior or media safety boundaries.
behavior_before: commandHistory.js exposed commandHistoryIssueLevel through both the mediaPipelineCommandHistory namespace and a direct window.commandHistoryIssueLevel flat alias; Home, Completed, Diagnostics, Launch, Launch History, and Queue Launch consumers still read the flat alias.
behavior_after: commandHistoryIssueLevel remains available through window.mediaPipelineCommandHistory only; touched WebView consumers read that namespace or receive the helper by dependency injection. The active flat-export total drops from 631 to 630.
manual_validation: PASS: node --check apps\desktop\webview\static\assets\commandHistory.js / app\home.js / launchHistoryView.js / queueView.launch.js / diagnosticsView.js / launchView.js
rollback_plan: Restore window.commandHistoryIssueLevel in commandHistory.js, switch the touched WebView consumers back to the flat alias, regenerate the WebView public contract/command-boundary artifacts and summaries, restore the inventory/current-state flat-export counts, and rerun the same WebView static and browser smoke checks.
